facts.why: The film calls it Barnum's American Museum (of Curiosity), and Barnum greets visitors with "Welcome to the Barnum Museum". "Museum of Wonders" is never said.

vibe.verdict: A good circus museum board with Barnum's real line and This Is Me cue, but the songs and the elephant arrival are mostly missing.
ideas: Swap 'Sideshow red toffee apples' for 'Elephant ears' fried dough, for Barnum's elephant arrival.
Replace 'Barnum's champagne cocktails' note with 'Raise a glass to the greatest show'.
Replace the 'Big top caramel popcorn' note with 'The Greatest Show' popcorn bucket.
Replace 'Combo 17' with 'The Greatest Combo': one of each, under the Barnum ringmaster hat.
iconic: Barnum arriving on an elephant at the recital
Men suffer more from imagining too little than too much
changed: Note now Barnum's real line about imagining too little
Popcorn renamed The Greatest Show caramel popcorn
Toffee apple note tied to the sideshow troupe
Cue now the troupe singing This Is Me
Last wink now Barnum's elephant arrival
